CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE RAJNISH BHATNAGAR  ORDER % 18.04.2023 1. Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.

3. The present application has been filed by the petitioner under Sections 438 Cr.P.C. seeking anticipatory bail in case FIR No. 710/2022 under Sections 498A/304B/34 IPC and 6 of POCSO Act registered at Police Station Neb Sarai Delhi.
Learned APP for the State appears on advance notice and accepts notice.

5. At the outset, it is submitted by learned APP for the State that the deceased was aged 14 years and 10 months when she died and at the time of marriage, the deceased was hardly 13 years and 4 months old.
6. On my query, learned APP submits that the original IO is not present today.

7. In view of this, issue notice to SHO, Neb Sarai to be present in the Court on the next date of hearing at 10:30 A.M.
8. List on 19th April 2023.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J APRIL 18, 2023 p Smt. Gajendri vs State Govt Of Nct Of Delhi on 18 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17814682/
